title: Wayfare Reserve Terms: Reservation Fee, Booking Window and Fee Refunds
content:
Wayfare Reserve lets a rider of **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** book a trip ahead for a reserved pickup time.

## 1. The reservation fee

The reservation fee is charged only on a reserved trip, once, when it is booked. Whether a trip is reserved is read from the trip's system record (its booking mode). The fee is the ride option's reservation fee.

## 2. What can be reserved, and how far ahead

A ride option can be reserved only when it is offered through Wayfare Reserve, and the reserved pickup time must be at least the ride option's shortest lead time (in minutes) after the moment of booking and no more than its furthest-ahead figure (in calendar days) after it. Both moments are taken from the trip record: the moment of booking and the reserved pickup time.

## 3. Wayfare Pass reservation fee waiver

When the rider's Wayfare Pass plan waives the reservation fee and the membership is in trial, active or pending cancellation status at booking, no fee is charged, and one waiver entry for the reservation fee with basis *Pass reservation fee* is written instead.

## 4. Refund of the reservation fee

The reservation fee is refunded in full when the trip ends unfulfilled (the ride option's refund-when-unfulfilled setting), or when the rider cancels because the driver had not arrived the ride option's driver-late minutes after the reserved pickup time (reason *reserved driver late*). A rider cancellation for any other reason keeps the reservation fee.

## Summary table

| How the reserved trip ended | Reservation fee |
|---|---|
| Unfulfilled (no driver found) | refunded in full |
| Rider cancelled; driver had not arrived the driver-late minutes after the reserved pickup time | refunded in full, reason reserved driver late |
| Rider cancelled for any other reason | kept |

## Booking-window cases (hypothetical shortest lead 30 minutes, furthest ahead 30 days)

- Booked 12:00, reserved pickup 12:30 the same day: exactly 30 minutes after booking — at least the lead time, accepted on this point.
- Booked 12:00, reserved pickup 12:29: less than 30 minutes — not accepted.
- A ride option not offered through Wayfare Reserve cannot be reserved at any lead time.
